observations: Photos show at least two orange LPG gas cylinders (foreign-used style) stored indoors against a wall.
Photo 0: foreground cylinder has a visible valve/regulator connection area; cylinder body shows wear/scuffs and some dents/scratches.
Photo 1: another cylinder behind/adjacent; similar wear and valve area visible.
Photo 2: close-up of a cylinder top/shoulder with a handle; body has printed markings but the exact brand/model and the 12.5kg marking are not clearly readable in the image.

claims.evidence: The photos show LPG cylinders, but the exact capacity/12.5kg marking is not clearly readable.
No test results, inspection stamp, or leak/pressure proof is shown in the photos.
Photos show wear (scratches/scuffs/dents), but durability/high-quality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg (could be another size).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (e.g., “12.5kg”) and serial/inspection markings on the body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic foreign-used LPG cylinder with unknown capacity.

risks.risk: Leak/valve condition not verifiable from photos (could leak at valve/regulator connection).
risks.proof: Video of a soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connection (and around the valve body) with no bubbles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free (treat as needing inspection/possible repair).

risks.risk: Cylinder safety/inspection status unknown (expiry/inspection date, requalification stamp).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the inspection/requalification stamp and dates on the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: Price as inspection status unknown/possibly expired.

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than it looks (hidden dents, corrosion, or impact damage).
risks.proof: Full 360° photos (top, bottom, and both sides) plus a close-up of any dents/corrosion spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with visible wear and potential minor damage.

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch (seller may be selling more/less than shown).
risks.proof: Photo showing all cylinders included in the deal laid out together, counted clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the worst-case quantity shown/assumed from photos (not guaranteed).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo showing the exact capacity marking (12.5kg) and any serial/ID on the cylinder body (not just the valve area).
Video of a soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connection (and around the valve body).
Clear photo of the cylinder’s inspection/requalification stamp and dates.
Full 360° photos of each cylinder (top, bottom, and all sides) including any dents/corrosion.
response.reason: The photos confirm LPG cylinders, but the key details that determine the correct price in Oyo (exact 12.5kg capacity, inspection status, and leak/valve safety) are not readable or provable from the images alone.
